question: _________ are an example of public goods and services.
solution:
The correct answer is __**roads**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Roads**:-

 
 
• **These are thoroughfares for the conveyance of traffic that mostly have an improved surface for use by vehicles (motorized and non-motorized) and pedestrians. **
 
• **It is an example of public goods and services.**
 
• Roads can be classified into a variety of types, including:
 
 
• **Highways**: These are high-speed roads with multiple lanes and limited access. They are typically used for long-distance travel.
 
• **Arterial roads:** These are major roads that connect cities and towns. They typically have multiple lanes and traffic signals.
 
• **Collector roads:** These roads connect arterial roads to local roads. They typically have fewer lanes and lower speed limits.
 
• **Local roads: **These roads provide access to individual homes and businesses. They typically have one lane in each direction and low speed limits.
